rules: Paper only. No real money, wallets, exchange or DEX keys, sign-ups, posts, or messages.
No unattended live execution. The October live Solana desk stays off.
Strategy A (risky, clock restarted 2026-11-24): virtual book $200. Max $10 per position. Max 6 open. No leverage. No averaging down. Target 2-4 new paper entries per cycle.
A daily realized loss stop -$25 (America/New_York). A evaluation drawdown fail line -$60. (B and C still use -$15 / -$40 on their own books.)
A hard rejects only: honeypot/sell-blocked; no quote or no pool; impersonation tickers; plus off-limits CLAUDIA/DARK. A fill also requires quote impact < 3% on a $10 size.
Mint/freeze, rug_ratio, bot_degen, bundler, age, liquidity, and venue flags are score penalties, not vetoes, unless rug_ratio > 0.50 or bot_degen >= 0.90.
Coordinator takes the top 2-4 by risky score that clear hard rejects and a fresh quote. A Risk reject is advisory, not a veto. Gemini, ChatGPT, and Jev are skipped_not_wired (Zack 2026-11-24).
Exits written before entry: full stop -25%, full take-profit +50%, 24h time stop. Marks/exits use a fresh quote each cycle. No moonbag.
A-strict (old gates: max 2 open, -$15 / -$40, rug 0.25, bot 0.75, bundler 0.40, unanimity) is scored as a shadow on the same names — decisions only, no second book.
No invented fills or marks. Corrections are new notes only. Facts vs narrative; narrative cannot pass a gate.
Existing routines (paper-memecoin-team-cycle, memecoin sweeps) are not modified.
Write only under the paper desk . Never call swap, buy, sell, or wallet scripts.

postsReviewed.author: AI__Brain
postsReviewed.verdict: Reject as a trading system. Promo account (CELE8EX). $141 to $13,962 overnight claim is promotional / illustrative, not evidence. Unattended live execution is forbidden.
postsReviewed.ideaWorthTesting: Keep Head-of-Desk / Risk / written-log process. Do not test the overnight wallet-connected sniper.

postsReviewed.author: lbang_2580
postsReviewed.verdict: Useful tooling, not a trading system. Google gemini-api-cli lets other agents call Gemini for images, PDFs, and research.
postsReviewed.ideaWorthTesting: Later, Zack-gated Gemini API as the reject seat and as a research helper. Does not change entry rules.

postsReviewed.author: immortalhowwl
postsReviewed.verdict: Reject as a trading system. The post itself calls the $412 to $38,947 night a fictional story. Same promo network (CELE8EX). Unattended 94x sniper is not to be run.
postsReviewed.ideaWorthTesting: Reason-before-entry, mint/LP/dev/honeypot checks, and wallet-cluster review as reject filters (already on the checklist). Do not run linked third-party trading repos with a funded key.

postsReviewed.author: obzidian_ai
postsReviewed.verdict: Launch/waitlist from a real Swiss company (Moonberg AG), not a CELE8EX fake-P&L. The 46s video is a product demo with illustrative boards, invented-looking tickers, and unaudited backtest stats — not evidence of edge. Same-day paid KOL posts, referral links, and airdrop/reward talk. Terms let a Privy wallet grant Obzidian a signing key for automations. Do not join the waitlist or connect a wallet.
postsReviewed.ideaWorthTesting: Test-first, confirm-before-arm, and rules-in-code are already on our checklist. Do not copy 24/7 auto-execution or wallet-connected automations.

postsReviewed.author: rgk_degen
postsReviewed.verdict: Reject as a trading system. The $3 to $186,420 (62,140x) seven-day claim is a fictional / engagement template: a $3 account cannot take a -$31,935 loss early on; the 'At which day would you have pulled the plug?' shape matches the CELE8EX promo; no wallet, tx links, or ledger; $KOI at 5x leverage breaks our rules. Keep the visual as dashboard design inspiration only — not evidence.
postsReviewed.ideaWorthTesting: From RGK's Aug 26 2026 'cost floor' note: prefer connectors/CLIs over the browser, stay quiet on uneventful runs, use a turn cap with a state file to resume from, and batch writes. The hourly routine already uses CLI scripts, no browser, and stays quiet. An explicit turn cap in ROUTINE_PROMPT.md is a proposal only and has not been added.

picks.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $55,000 in November?
picks.reasoning: BTC spot ~$59,840 at 4:38 PM ET Nov 24; $55,000 is ~8.1% below with ~6.3 days left (Binance 1m low through Nov 30 11:59 PM ET). Driftless barrier model on 14 days of Coinbase hourly returns (realized vol ~69% annualized) gives ~35% touch odds; 1m wicks add a little, but realized vol includes the Nov 12-21 crash and may overstate the next week, so team estimate 32%. Bear case for Yes: BTC already bounced off ~$55.1K on Nov 21 without printing $55K, and buyers defended that zone. Market ~27%: edge

picks.question: Will the Fed increase interest rates by 25 bps after the December 2026 meeting?
picks.reasoning: CME FedWatch shows ~95.1-95.9% for a 25bp hike at Dec 8-9; Williams did not rule out consecutive moves. Market ask 0.94 so no edge. Bear case: Waller wants 50bp (4-5% tail), which would resolve to a different bracket.

picks.question: Israel x Iran ceasefire continues through November 30?
picks.reasoning: Reports say US-Iran exchange limited strikes and Hormuz tankers are being hit, but the market needs a direct Israel<->Iran air/missile strike by Nov 30; Iran threatens retaliation if struck. Estimate slightly below market 0.92-0.93, below the edge threshold. Bear case: escalation or a qualifying strike in the 6 days left.

picks.question: Will Chiang Wan-an win the next Taipei Mayor election?
picks.reasoning: Final pre-blackout polls are split: TVBS 46-44 Chiang, ETtoday Chiang ahead, two other polls have Shen ahead (one by 5). Dead heat with a lead that shrank from 28 pts in May. Incumbent edge and 10% undecided keep me near a coin flip, slightly Chiang. Bear case: momentum clearly toward Shen, so this Yes could be overpriced.

picks.question: Will Kuomintang (KMT) win the most head of local government elections in the 2026 Taiwan local elections?
picks.reasoning: KMT holds 15 of 22 seats; PollTrack poll-lead map (Nov 17) has DPP 9, KMT 7, 5 unpolled and 1 independent, with the unpolled seats largely rural/eastern/outlying where KMT is strong. DPP needs a big swing to out-seat KMT. Bear case: a national DPP wave (DPP preferred 43% vs 27%) could flip several seats.

picks.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $52,500 in November?
picks.reasoning: BTC closed ~$59.8-60.0k on Nov 24 (low 59.2k), so $52,500 is ~12% below with about 6 days left. Rough touch probability at ~3% daily vol is ~10%, fat tails included. Market 0.105 is about fair, no edge. Bear case: a sharp liquidation or geopolitical shock (Hormuz) could extend the Nov 23-24 selloff.

picks.question: US announces end of Iranian blockade by December 15, 2026?
picks.reasoning: Trump said Tuesday no talks are underway or planned and the blockade continues; Iran demands lifting it before talks, while Qatar tries to revive negotiations. An official end announcement by Dec 15 would need a fast deal. Market 0.075 is slightly high but no edge on Yes. Bear case: sudden Qatar-brokered breakthrough.

picks.question: Packers vs. Rams: O/U 44.5
